answers.answer: The on-screen caption says 'thì cái lưu ý đây là' (or 'thì cái lưu ý đấy là').

It starts as an empty horizontal search bar with a glowing cyan and red outline, then transitions into a white search bar containing a magnifying glass icon, the account handle '@tu.phu.ngo.triet', and a small TikTok logo.
At the start, the TikTok logo and handle are on the middle-left side of the frame; after about 5 seconds, it moves to the bottom-right corner.
2 times (first at the start from 00:00 to 00:03, and second at 02:10 to 02:15).
A large silver and blue sword (model / replica / toy sword) held in front of the camera.
A yellow origami / folded paper object (spiky modular origami polyhedron/star).
